body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0032848 negative regulation of cellular pH reduction -> replaced by GO:0051454 intracellular pH elevation
GO:0032849 positive regulation of cellular pH reduction -> replaced by GO:0051452 intracellular pH reduction
GO:0032847 regulation of cellular pH reduction -> consider GO:0051454 intracellular pH elevation GO:0051452 intracellular pH reduction
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29164

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KpHKNgNH_6fthMvCeWlqHwD6i18NF9_FSs1FojKt-WU/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
UniProt	1
RGD	4

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to (positive/negative) regulation of cellular pH reduction
